lines.speaker: Spook
lines.text: It's found me twice already tonight. I don't know how — I didn't burn a thing, I swear it.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Then it's not tracking metal. Move — I'll cover you.

lines.speaker: Spook
lines.text: Don't let it get a straight look at either of us. I've heard what those spikes do up close.
